title: Privacy and data
subject: Re: {original_subject}
body:
Hi{from_name_greeting},

Thanks for your question about privacy.

Ben keeps your bills on your device by default. Bill photos and details are not uploaded to our servers unless you use email-in, in which case attachments are held briefly so the app can fetch them, then removed after you confirm.

We do not sell your data. Our privacy policy is at https://benandbill.app/privacy if you would like the full detail.

If you have a specific concern, reply and we will answer it directly.

Kind regards,
Ben support
